model_answer.id: "Hello!" artinya halo.
Hello = halo, Goodbye = sampai jumpa, Thank you = terima kasih, Sorry = maaf.
model_answer.en: Hello, goodbye, thank you, sorry: words for every day.

model_answer.id: "Good morning!" artinya selamat pagi.
model_answer.en: "Good morning!" is what we say in the morning.

model_answer.id: Nose artinya hidung.
eye = mata, ear = telinga, hand = tangan, foot = kaki.
model_answer.en: Eye, ear, hand, foot: parts of your body.

model_answer.id: "I'm happy" artinya aku senang.
Anak laki-laki ini berkata: I am a boy.
model_answer.en: The boy says: I am a boy.

model_answer.id: Datang: Hello! Hi! Good morning! Pergi: Bye! Goodbye! Good night!
model_answer.en: Arriving: Hello! Hi! Good morning! Leaving: Bye! Goodbye! Good night!

model_answer.en: Happy, sad, tired, hungry: four feelings.

model_answer.id: Hello! I am Sari. Pasangan I adalah am.
model_answer.en: Hello! I am Sari. With I, we say am.

model_answer.id: Besok pagi, sapa keluargamu: "Good morning!" Saat mau tidur, ucapkan: "Good night!"
model_answer.en: Tomorrow morning, greet your family: "Good morning!" At bedtime, say: "Good night!"

items.source: Online Etymology Dictionary, "goodbye" (etymonline.com/word/good-bye: 1590s, contraction of "God be with ye"); Merriam-Webster, "goodbye" (word history).

model_answer.id: Dulu orang Inggris berpamitan dengan "God be with ye" (Tuhan menyertaimu). Lama-lama ucapan itu memendek menjadi "goodbye".
model_answer.en: Long ago, English speakers said "God be with ye" when they left. Over time it got shorter and became "goodbye".

model_answer.id: "Goodbye!" diucapkan saat berpisah.
Foot artinya kaki.
"I'm tired" artinya aku capek.
model_answer.en: "I'm tired" means you need a rest.

model_answer.id: Three artinya tiga.
four = 4, six = 6, eight = 8, ten = 10.
Seven artinya tujuh.
Urutannya: one, two, three, four, five.
R-E-D: red, merah.

red = merah, yellow = kuning, green = hijau, white = putih.
Twelve artinya dua belas.
Three eggs: lebih dari satu, jadi tambah -s.
model_answer.en: Three eggs: more than one, so add -s.

model_answer.id: Ada -s berarti lebih dari satu: dogs, pens, eggs.
model_answer.en: An -s means more than one: dogs, pens, eggs.

model_answer.id: Fifteen artinya lima belas.

items.source: Online Etymology Dictionary, "eleven" and "twelve" (etymonline.com/word/eleven, /word/twelve: Old English endleofan / twelf, from Proto-Germanic *ainlif- "one left" and *twa-lif- "two left" over ten).

model_answer.id: Kenapa bukan "one-teen" dan "two-teen"? Eleven dan twelve kata yang sangat tua. Dulu artinya kira-kira "sisa satu" dan "sisa dua": sisa setelah menghitung sampai sepuluh!
model_answer.en: Why not "one-teen" and "two-teen"? Eleven and twelve are very old words. They once meant something like "one left" and "two left": what's left after counting to ten!

model_answer.id: one = 1, two = 2, nine = 9, five = 5.
blue = biru, black = hitam, orange = oranye, brown = cokelat.

model_answer.en: Five marbles: more than one, so add -s.

items.source: Online Etymology Dictionary, "orangutan" (etymonline.com/word/orangutan: from Malay orang "man" + utan, hutan "forest"); Merriam-Webster, "orangutan" (etymology).

model_answer.id: Kata Inggris "orangutan" berasal dari bahasa Melayu: orang + hutan. Jadi, ada kata Inggris yang lahir dari bahasa kita!
model_answer.en: The English word "orangutan" comes from Malay: orang (person) + hutan (forest). So some English words come from our language!

model_answer.en: A monkey loves to climb trees.

meaning.id: Aku hewan. Nama Inggrisku dimulai dengan huruf C. Aku berbunyi "meong". Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I'm an animal. My English name starts with C. I say "meow". Who am I?

model_answer.id: Cat! Kucing berbunyi meong. Cow dan chicken juga dimulai dengan C.
model_answer.en: Cat! A cat says meow. Cow and chicken start with C too.

meaning.id: Campurkan warna merah dan warna kuning. Jadi warna apa?
meaning.en: Mix red and yellow paint. What color do you get?

model_answer.id: Merah + kuning = orange (oranye).
